field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Models actually invoked; [] for tasks with no LLM.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Preserve each frozen criterion, actual value and pass/fail independently of task completion.
field_principles.causal_control_rows: Keep update withholding and every unsafe transaction mutation.
field_principles.causal_summary: Recompute later change, pre-release difference, and reactivation counts.
field_principles.comparison_rows: Rebuild fixed paired-seed intervals without producer aggregates.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the actual UTC end separately from the fixed run date.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: True; assess prospective utility and rollback of learned constraint reuse.
field_principles.control_summary: Retain identical-input drift and shuffled-candidate coverage.
field_principles.cross_domain_transfer_claimed: This finite fixture supplies no cross-domain transfer evidence.
field_principles.current_generation_count: Count only generations in this task.
field_principles.current_inference_count: Count only model inference calls in this task.
field_principles.current_model_load_count: Count only model loads in this task.
field_principles.default_pipeline_modified: The audit does not change a production default.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured monotonic elapsed work; record phase spans separately.
field_principles.execution_venue: Top-level orchestration is host; board rows name kv260, gatemate or polarfire.
field_principles.experiment_id: A fixed identifier prevents another task from supplying this audit.
field_principles.field_principles: Keep ordinary values at top level; put their explanations in this map.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names check, upstream, artifact_field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claimed: CPU replay does not imply the future 100-times hardware target.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_ or complete:. External absence starts blocked_.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for the operation actually executed.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Actual class determines the duration floor; never pad duration or relabel to pass.
field_principles.methodology: State raw reduction, fresh restore, authority denial, and oracle limits.
field_principles.milestone: Bind this result to the V637 recurrence-memory audit.
field_principles.model_invoked: Current task execution only; historical sources and injected fixtures are separate.
field_principles.mutation_receipt_path: Separate hashed negative-fixture sidecar, never current invocation provenance.
field_principles.no_model_weight_mutation: This audit changes finite memory only, not model weights.
field_principles.phase_spans_s: Keep measured monotonic spans for every numbered audit phase.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Observed paths, resources, model identity and upstream checks before expensive work.
field_principles.publication_performed: This task does not publish, upload, or submit results.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze seeds and schedules before observing evaluation labels.
field_principles.raw_check_rows: Retain chronology, request-index joins, hashes, and denominator checks.
field_principles.recomputed_seed_rows: Full per-stream, per-arm metrics independent of producer aggregate calculations.
field_principles.recurrence_audit_complete_score: Complete cold reduction or explicit externally blocked disposition.
field_principles.recurrence_promotion_score: Independent reproduction of efficacy plus all causal safety criteria.
field_principles.reducer_process_receipt: Prove reduction and restore ran in one isolated fresh process.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash the exact settings, inputs and raw rows supporting the result.
field_principles.restore_rows: Compare restored actions, energies, active hashes, and archive hashes.
field_principles.rows: Every comparison retains one row per independent unit and arm, with errors and abstentions.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260912; retain actual UTC start and end timestamps.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Predeclared independent units, attempted/completed/censored units, and stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact and bind experiment_id and milestone to this task.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hash source code, public inputs, private evaluator inputs and raw output files.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC start separately from the fixed run date.
field_principles.status: Terminal complete or blocked only; unfinished work uses a separate checkpoint path.
field_principles.upstream_receipts: Keep Exp7240 readiness separate from Exp7241 learning value.
field_principles.validation_command_receipts: Record scoped validation commands without claiming unrun checks.
field_principles.verdict_class: Exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when the verification authority also defines correctness; separate code is insufficient independence.

honest_verdict: complete_null: recurrence audit completed but promotion criteria did not all pass

methodology.oracle_limit: the exact evaluator also defines correctness

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: all predeclared streams once; no outcome-based extension
